audience: small businesses and freelancers who invoice customers with smallinvoice

useCases.title: Check the invoices of a customer
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by contact with number, dates, total and status, opens one with its positions, and lists the payments recorded on it.

useCases.title: Review offers and order confirmations
useCases.text: The AI lists offers (quotes) and order confirmations by contact and opens one with its positions and totals.

useCases.title: Find a customer or supplier
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts (companies or persons) and opens one with its main address, all addresses and the contact persons of a company.

useCases.title: Review hours and efforts per project
useCases.text: The AI lists projects, recorded working hours and efforts (expenses and services booked on projects), so you can see what to bill.

useCases.title: Add a customer company
useCases.text: The AI checks the contacts first, then creates a new company contact with its main address. Nothing is sent to anyone.

useCases.title: Create an invoice for a customer
useCases.text: The AI looks up the contact and the unit ids and creates an invoice. It is only created, not sent; you review it in smallinvoice.
